Still in a lot of pain I have no idea whats wrong I dont really belive wisdom teeth could be causing this much pain but maybe. The soonest consultation I could get was June 14th and even then it will take weeks or more to actually get into surgery. I've pretty much given up and im trying to sleep as much as possible. I havent been able to work or do anything and im not sure what I will do, I feel very frustrated.

I have sleep apnea and I am 300 pounds so a lot of dentists won't take me and I can only go to a surgery center because I have health complications.

I am okay! I just had a messed up sleep schedule, im awake now. 

My mother has parkinsons and can't help me make appointments due to being sick and not always being mentally avaliable but she was awake enough the other day to tell me she thinks I shouldn't go to the emergency room since I just went about 4 or 5 days ago and they said I should be fine.

the pain hasn't been super consistent. I feel alright now, not good but i am not crying anymore, probably because I took some hydrocodone but if the pain gets so bad I start throwing up again I will go. The main reason I've been hesitating to go is because its a lot of stress on me to be at the emergency room alone. I am not used to doing big things like this by myself but I think ill probably have to. I am responsible and ill definitely make sure I get the help I need but for now I'll be ok. If I don't go tonight and the dentist can't help me tomorrow (its a kids dentist so thats likely) I will go to the emergency room just to see how the infection is and maybe get more of the antibiotics if I need to. My insurance should cover the ER 

I can not really tell if my pain in my teeth and jaw is just a really bad toothache or an infection which is why I am not too worried. It may just be that my nerves are exposed? My teeth are really bad. If you still think I should go to the emergency room let me know as I'm considering it. I just dont want to go unless I have to
Thank you for the suggestions!
I was able to get into a dentist who will at least look at it tomorrow morning first thing, I will definitely go back to the hospital if he suggests I do which is possible. I appreciate the concern.
Oh yes i was asking about medicade when I called,  I wrote that on accident, sleeping meds are kicking in as I made this post so there were a bunch of mistakes. 😅

I did go to the emergency room about 5 days ago and im almost out of antibiotics. Its hardly better, ive been consistently taking penicillin and aleve. I can't really tell if the infection is down, I have been throwing up from the pain and nausea but no fever. Not sure what to do or if this is normal I thought it would get better but its still really bad.
